mechanism: Lopinavir/ritonavir inhibits CYP3A4 and can impair renal potassium excretion, increasing serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or on concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess renal function; use potassium supplementation cautiously and only when indicated; educate patients on high-potassium foods to avoid.
